description: The id an event mints for itself: `prefix` followed by `suffix_length` characters of `alphabet` (lowercase Crockford base32), i.e. a TypeID over a fresh UUIDv7. The first suffix character is at most `first_char_max` (the suffix encodes 128 bits), the UUID's version nibble is `uuid_version`, and its variant bits are 10. Ids are random, so no vector pins a value; `distinct` ids minted in a row must all differ. A decoded id is kept verbatim, whatever it holds (see event_json.json).
